ResearchProjectDef.label: automated biofuel refinery kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked automated biofuel refinery back into crude service. Needs a wrecked automated biofuel refinery that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked automated biofuel refinery where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated biofuel refinery refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to bring a kludged automated biofuel refinery close to what it was. This is not the original engineering, which its makers already solved. It is the colony's own hard-won knowledge of how to bring a dead one back. Needs a kludged automated biofuel refinery that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged automated biofuel refinery where it stands. It needs an ancient component.
